adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Dave and Kurt are tied up together when Sonny Burch raids the X-Con office. They later arrive at the pier together and taser Burch's men.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: X-Con partner. Tasers Burch's men with Dave at the pier.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: X-Con partner, tied up with Kurt when Burch raids the office.
adds.evidence: Burch ties up Luis, Dave and Kurt at the X-Con office; Dave and Kurt then arrive at Pier 39 and taser Burch's men.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Dave and Luis are tied up together when Sonny Burch drugs Luis into giving up Scott's location. At the pier, Dave and Kurt taser Burch's men just as Burch is about to kill Luis.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: X-Con partner, whom Dave saves from Burch at the pier.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: X-Con partner who tasers Burch's men to save Luis.
adds.evidence: Burch ties up Luis, Dave and Kurt and injects Luis with truth serum; at the docks Burch is about to kill Luis when Kurt and Dave arrive and taser his men.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Dave runs X-Con Security with Scott and helps hide him, Hank and Hope at the office after the lab is stolen. They celebrate together when the firm lands a big new client.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: X-Con partner. Celebrates landing a big client with Dave.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: X-Con partner who helps hide Scott, Hank and Hope at the office.
adds.evidence: Dave, Kurt and Luis assist Hank and Hope when Scott brings them to the X-Con office; Dave, Scott, Luis and Kurt celebrate Karapetyan's offer.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Kurt and the X-Con crew hide Hank, Hope and Scott at their office after Ghost steals the lab.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's X-Con partner, who helps hide Hank at the office.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Kurt helps hide at the X-Con office after his lab is stolen.
adds.evidence: Dave's page: 'he, Kurt, and Luis assisted Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne when Lang brought them to the office.' Kurt's part in the scene is small.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Luis hides Hank, Hope and Scott at the X-Con office after Ghost steals the lab, teasing Hank for turning to the crew again. He later drives Hank and Janet away from the docks in his van.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's X-Con partner, who hides Hank at the office and drives him away from the docks.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hope's father, whom Luis hides at the X-Con office.
adds.evidence: Luis hides them at the X-Con office ('once again, in your hour of need that you would turn to us' / 'Not me.') and later drives Scott, Hope, Hank and Janet away in his van.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Paxton hugs Scott and tells him he is proud of him, and calms Maggie when the FBI searches Scott's house. He joins the family hug when Scott's house arrest ends.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's father, whom Paxton hugs and tells he is proud of.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Cassie's stepfather, who tells Scott he is proud of him.
adds.evidence: Paxton gives Scott an extra hug ('I'm proud of you, bud'), tells Maggie the FBI search is not harassment, and joins the group hug when Scott is freed.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Luis rides in Hope's van during the chase for the lab, and she shrinks it to slip past Sonny Burch's men. She has him grow a toy car to bring her the lab's remote.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's X-Con partner, who rides with Hope in the chase for the lab.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hank's daughter, who drives Luis through the chase for the lab.
adds.evidence: Luis joins Hope in her van; she shrinks it to escape Burch's fleet, then tells him to bring the remote using the Hot Wheels car collection.
